goal: Make Provider transport success explicitly pass strict planning validation before admission, while accepting safely extractable single JSON objects without an unnecessary live repair call.
acceptance_criteria: A safely extractable single JSON object reaches the existing strict planning schema validator without a live envelope-repair request.
Invalid JSON or invalid planning schema remains unadmitted and produces no candidate input artifact.
Admission is represented by a validated materialized planning artifact and an identity-bound admission event, not by flipping a reporting flag.
Timeout diagnostics remain distinct from generation admission.
Zero-API admission, provenance, formal-chain, kernel, and management tests pass before canonical publication.

quality_metrics.measure: invalid Provider responses admitted into planning
safely extractable valid JSON responses requiring a second Provider call

prevention: Separate transport success, schema validation, and formal admission
assurance: Replay timeout and structured-response cases without Provider calls
control: Run admission and provenance regressions before canonical publication
improvement: Persist safe admission/failure events so HTTP success cannot be mistaken for formal success

interface_expectations: provider_stage_checkpoint remains the sole planning-artifact admission boundary
ProviderModelRoutingPolicy and sealed brief forwarding remain intact
A validated artifact reference is the candidate-planning handoff
Formal evidence and resume safety remain derived
